gaps.explanation: 'It's' is short for 'it is' or 'it has'; here it means 'it has been raining'. The possessive is 'its'.

gaps.sentence: He gave a ___ summary of the 40-page report.
gaps.explanation: 'A brief summary' — adjective; 'briefly' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: The factory ___ waste into the river for years before being fined.
gaps.explanation: 'Discharge waste' = release it into the environment.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't ___ what he was saying because of the noise.
gaps.explanation: 'Hear' means to receive sound; 'listen' means to pay attention deliberately and needs 'to'.

gaps.sentence: The consultant will ___ us on every stage of the merger.
gaps.explanation: 'Advise' is the verb; 'advice' is the noun.

gaps.hint: the uncountable activity of travelling in general
gaps.explanation: 'Travel' is uncountable when it means travelling in general; the other options are countable nouns.
'Who's' is short for 'who is'; 'whose' asks about possession.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ to rain later, so take a coat.
gaps.explanation: 'It's likely to rain' — probable; 'alike' means similar.
